item.title: Thunderstorm Tonight in Kalimantan Tengah
item.description: Thunderstorms and heavy rainfall are forecasted to occur starting from 24 November 2026, 00:20 WIB in parts of Kalimantan Tengah especially in: BUKIT RAYA, MARIKIT, SERUYAN HULU, SULING TAMBUN, TELUK SAMPIT. These conditions may lead to reduced visibility, strong winds, and localized flooding. The public is strongly advised to remain vigilant during this period, limit outdoor activities, and take all necessary precautions to ensure safety. Conditions are expected to gradually improve by 24 November 2026, 03:30 WIB.
